chunks: Hamza ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim informed me in the year 307 AH. He said: My father narrated to me, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon them both), from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:
O Ali! You are my brother, my vizier, and the bearer of my standard in this world and the Hereafter. You are the master of my Pond. Whoever loves you has loved me, and whoever hates you has hated me.

key_terms.حوضي: My Pond -- referring to al-Hawd (the Pond of Kawthar) in the Hereafter
key_terms.لوائي: My standard/banner -- the banner of the Prophet, to be carried by Ali on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.وزيري: My vizier/minister -- a title denoting Ali as the Prophet's chief aide, paralleling Harun to Musa

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say to Imam Ali about being his brother and standard bearer?
ai.summary: In this hadith transmitted through the golden chain (silsilat al-dhahab) of the Imams from the Ahl al-Bayt, Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Imam Ali (AS) with several exalted titles: brother, vizier (minister/helper), standard-bearer in both worlds, and keeper of the Pond (Hawd al-Kawthar). The Prophet further establishes an inseparable bond between love and hatred for Ali and love and hatred for the Prophet himself. This teaching was significant for the early Muslim community as it established Ali's unique spiritual and political authority alongside the Prophet.

en.bilal-muhammad: Hamza b. Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Zayd b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim informed me in 307 AH. He said: My father narrated to me from Ali b. Mu`abbad from al-Husayn b. Khalid from `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
O `Ali! You are my brother, my vizier, and my standard bearer in this world and the Hereafter. You are the master of my Pond. Whoever loves you has loved me, and whoever hates you has hated me.
